_meta.name: IntelliAudit Citation Rulebook v0.4
_meta.purpose: Rule-FIRST error injection. Each rule pre-specifies the violated standard so the citation ground truth is deterministic and independent of any LLM. The generator applies a rule's injection recipe to a concept-tagged clean statement and emits the rule's citation as ground truth.
_meta.citation_ground_truth_policy: Governing paragraph per docs/CITATION_POLICY.md. A rulebook string is not ground truth: linkbase-verified requires CitationResolver.paragraph_verified (exact paragraph, not subtopic). Otherwise the tier is expert-authored-UNVALIDATED, or the rule is detection-only. DQC ids are not ground truth and are not stored.
_meta.scoring: Exact match on ASC code at three granularities: topic (606), subtopic (606-10), full (606-10-25-1). Report EM@topic / EM@subtopic / EM@full. This replaces AuditBench's fuzzy Top-K-over-vague-prose metric.

citation-policy: governing paragraph is docs/CITATION_POLICY.md. Section-only codes replaced with the paragraph that policy names. Every asserted ASC is expert-authored-UNVALIDATED until paragraph_verified says otherwise. DQC id strings removed.

v0.4: citable rules no longer break footing. move_row recomputes the subtotals it moves between; measurement/recognition rules post the other side of the entry (retained earnings, AOCI, or the income-statement chain). Citable cases are the ones arithmetic cannot find.
v0.4: 'ledger' = as_booked for measurement/recognition rules: the company booked what it reported, so the violation is only visible in the supporting facts.
v0.4: 'facts' names the supporting-fact kind (src/evidence.py). Consistent facts of every kind appear on clean controls and other records, so a fact's presence carries no signal.

citation.rationale: Presentation wins over 330/310. ASC 210-10-45-1 lists receivables, inventory, and prepaid expenses as current assets. Placing one of those lines in noncurrent assets violates that sentence. Subject topics measure the asset; they do not assign the section. Not linkbase-verified until paragraph_verified matches the concept.

citation.rationale: Presentation wins. Eligible lines are operating-cycle liabilities (payables, accruals, collections in advance), which ASC 210-10-45-8 lists as current. ASC 210-10-45-5 only requires a total of current liabilities and does not govern this fault. 606 governs when deferred revenue is recognized, not which caption it uses.

citation.rationale: Presentation wins. The injection moves LongTermDebtNoncurrent into current liabilities and supplies no due-on-demand, callable, or refinancing fact. ASC 210-10-45-7 hands only those three facts to 470-10-45; without one of them, 470 does not win. ASC 210-10-45-12 says current liabilities do not include long-term obligations incurred for long periods. A section-only 'ASC 470-10-45' is not a paragraph and is not asserted.

citation.rationale: Presentation wins over 360. The injection moves PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment from investing to operating. ASC 230-10-45-13(c) classifies those payments as investing outflows. Topic 360 measures PPE and does not classify the cash flow. The scored code is the paragraph; subparagraph (c) is the operative sentence. A section-only 'ASC 230-10-45' is not asserted.

rules.detection_predicate: cash-flow concept under a section inconsistent with its ASC 230 classification

injection.narrative: prematurely recognized revenue for goods/services not yet transferred

citation.rationale: Subject wins over 220. The injection overstates revenue for goods or services not yet transferred. ASC 606-10-25-23 requires recognition when the performance obligation is satisfied by transferring control. ASC 606-10-25-1 is the contract-existence test and is not asserted. Topic 220 only governs income-statement display.

rules.detection_predicate: facts show unsatisfied obligations not carried in contract liabilities; income statement still foots

citation.rationale: Subject wins over 210. The injection relabels an operating lease as finance (or the reverse). ASC 842-10-25-2 is the lessee classification criteria. Topic 210 assigns current vs noncurrent; it does not decide finance vs operating.

injection.narrative: inventory carried above net realizable value; required write-down omitted

citation.rationale: Subject wins over 210. The injection carries inventory above NRV. ASC 330-10-35-1B requires the lower of cost and net realizable value for methods other than LIFO and retail. ASC 210-10-45-1 only lists inventory as a current asset. UNVALIDATED in part because the filing's cost method is not in the record; LIFO would be a different paragraph.

rules.detection_predicate: inventory carrying amount > NRV stated in the supporting facts; statement still foots

injection.narrative: goodwill carried above its implied fair value; required impairment not recognised

citation.rationale: Subject wins over 210. The injection carries goodwill without the impairment the narrative describes. ASC 350-20-35-1 is the sentence that goodwill is not amortized and is tested for impairment. Topic 210 does not measure goodwill. The loss amount is developed in later paragraphs of 350-20-35, so this citation stays expert-authored-UNVALIDATED.

rules.detection_predicate: reporting-unit carrying amount > fair value in the facts, goodwill not reduced; statement still foots

injection.narrative: available-for-sale securities not carried at fair value

citation.rationale: Subject wins over 210 for available-for-sale debt securities. ASC 320-10-35-1 is the subsequent-measurement sentence (fair value). ASC 210-10-45-1(f) only places marketable securities of operating cash in current assets. Unlabeled MarketableSecurities concepts may be equity securities under ASC 321, which is why this rule is expert-authored-UNVALIDATED rather than verified.

rules.detection_predicate: AFS carrying amount != fair value in the facts; statement still foots (AOCI absorbs it)

citation.rationale: Presentation wins over 505. The injection moves a dividend payment or a share repurchase from financing to operating. ASC 230-10-45-15(a) lists payments of dividends and outlays to reacquire the entity's equity instruments as financing outflows. Topic 505 governs the equity accounts, not the cash-flow class.

rules.detection_predicate: distribution to owners shown in operating activities

injection.narrative: allowance for credit losses below the expected credit losses the entity estimated

citation.rationale: Subject wins over 210 and 310. The facts give an expected-credit-loss estimate larger than the allowance booked. ASC 326-20-30-1 requires an allowance that presents the net amount expected to be collected. 210 only classifies receivables; 310-10-45 is presentation.

rules.detection_predicate: allowance recorded < expected credit losses in the facts

injection.narrative: asset group not recoverable and carried above fair value; impairment loss not recognized

citation.rationale: Subject wins over 210. The facts show an asset group whose carrying amount exceeds both its undiscounted cash flows and its fair value, with no loss recorded. ASC 360-10-35-17 recognizes an impairment loss only when the carrying amount is not recoverable and exceeds fair value. Decoys include groups that are recoverable on undiscounted flows even though fair value is lower (no loss under 360).

rules.detection_predicate: undiscounted flows < carrying amount and fair value < carrying amount in the facts, no loss

injection.narrative: covenant breach at period-end makes the debt callable within a year; debt left in non-current liabilities

citation.rationale: The handoff 210-10-45-7 describes: the record contains a callable-debt fact, so 470 wins over 210. ASC 470-10-45-11 requires current classification of long-term obligations callable because of a covenant violation at the balance-sheet date, unless the creditor waives the right for more than one year. Contrast R03 (no such fact), which stays 210-10-45-12.

rules.detection_predicate: facts show an unwaived (or <12-month waived) covenant breach; debt still non-current

injection.narrative: valuation allowance smaller than the portion not more-likely-than-not realizable

citation.rationale: Subject wins over 210. ASC 740-10-30-5(e) reduces deferred tax assets by a valuation allowance for the portion that is more likely than not not to be realized. The facts give a realizable amount below the net asset carried. The scored code is the paragraph; (e) is the operative subparagraph.

rules.detection_predicate: net DTA carried > amount more likely than not realizable in the facts

injection.narrative: development-phase costs capitalized instead of expensed

citation.rationale: Subject wins over 220. The facts show research and development costs deferred to the balance sheet. ASC 730-10-25-1 requires research and development costs to be charged to expense when incurred. Under IFRS (IAS 38.57) development costs meeting the criteria must be capitalized; that is a framework difference the IFRS rulebook keeps.

rules.detection_predicate: facts show R&D costs capitalized; income statement still foots
